verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Expensify connects to QuickBooks Online, automatically exporting finalized reports and syncing expenses, and also connects to NetSuite for expense syncing. A marketing line claims 'multi-level GL coding.' However, no evidence shows user-controlled mapping of GL accounts, classes, or departments, and Xero is not mentioned. Missing for 10: Xero integration evidence, documented GL account/class/department mapping configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync behavior.
